about: M4.1 personalization evaluator cases. Source of truth: multi-stores-shared/src/personalization/. Byte copies live in the api and web personalization folders; every copy runs every case. evaluate: `defs` names a set in `defs` (or is a list); `ctx` is merged over baseContext; `expect.lines` entries are partial (toMatchObject) and the line count must match; `compareToM40` also checks errors/values against validatePersonalization on the M4.0-type top-level fields; `sameAs`/`differentFrom` compare lineKey of the canonical values. Every app-on case also checks: re-evaluating the canonical values gives the same values and price, and the line deltas sum to priceDeltaMinor. `evaluateGuards` (same format as `evaluate`) holds the price-guard cases: prototype keys never price, and a delta that does not fit Decimal(10,2) is the PERSONALIZATION_PRICE_TOO_HIGH error.
